scores.evidence: o3 now reads 「Claude Codeを入れて起動し、質問 → 小さな変更 → 差分の確認 → コミットの流れで…実行できる」, so q3 (fresh session) and q7 (plan, installer, Node.js) assess what it says. Each objective has 2 or more graded questions with objectiveId (o1: q1, q5; o2: q2, q6; o3: q3, q4, q7, q8, q9), and o2 and o3 have apply- or analyze-level items (q2, q6, q7, q9).

hook-problem gives a concrete pain in three sentences (「ファイルを貼り付け、答えを書き写すことになりがちです」) and states the lesson's goal. The ungraded predict q0 uses chat, completion and memory as distractors, and the lesson corrects all three later.

Prerequisites are explicit. Terms are defined before the checks that use them (loop-defs, surfaces-defs, session-defs, example-defs), and 「Consoleアカウント」 is now explained in install-how (「ConsoleアカウントではAPI…を前払いで使えます」) and in the glossary. 「ネイティブインストーラー（native installer）」 first appears in surfaces-table and is never defined. q2 also depends on push, which the prerequisites do not name (they mention only commit).

measure.mjs reports 「prose 1585 (budget 1,200–2,400) · read 2405 · practice reading 806 · questions 10 · est 15.8 min (must be ≤ 20; estMinutes 16)」, and lint is clean. The surfaces segment defines 3 terms but also brings in IDE, CLI and 「ネイティブインストーラー」 in its table, which puts it over the 3-new-terms budget in practice.

example-steps gives 5 labelled steps (①–⑤), each with its reason (「頼んでいない変更を見つけるためです」) and an expect. The new example-diff shows the exact lines step ③ produces, and practice-steps fades the same labels. The example never shows why the starting page is committed first, so p-base arrives unexplained, and there is only one level of fading.

The density rule is met (q1–q4), and q2 now requires applying the 「先にpushする」 constraint to unpushed commits, while q3 and q4 need real application. q1's answer a (「実行してエラーを読み、直してから、もう一度実行して確かめる」) restates the loop-diagram description almost word for word, and option d is the only other option that mentions acting, so the item can be answered by matching words.

All five misconceptions in the brief are corrected with a reason: chat and completion (q0, q1, q5), memory (q3, q5-d), Node.js (install-node 「npmで入れる場合の手順です」, q7-a), the Free plan (q7-c) and 「完了しました」 (q4-a, q9-a). Every wrong option has feedback of 2 sentences or fewer, and q9-d is now a real misconception (「理由は聞かずに、自分で `about.html` を戻して…」).

loop-diagram is a 5-node process diagram whose labels match the definition. Its caption states the point (「確かめて足りなければ、情報を集める段階に戻る」) and its alt text is complete. The two tables carry the comparisons, example-diff shows the real artefact, and there are no decorative images.

The task is authentic and runs in a throwaway folder. Every step has an expect, p-base now checks the heading before the first commit, practice-prompt-explain carries a model answer, and practice-checklist has 6 observable criteria. The hint ladder has at most two rungs (hint, then troubleshoot on p-start, p-base and p-change), and p-commit has no hint.

summary-points (5 points) comes after the exam. summary-next asks a reflection question tied to the practice (「演習で、確認なしで進んだ操作はありましたか。」) and names 第2回. The 7 cards in summary-cards now match the body (card-version 「バージョン番号が出れば成功です」, card-carry without --resume) and are cited, and askTutor follows.

The version is pinned (「2026年10月時点（v2.1.304）」, auto mode from v2.1.283), the installer commands match cc-setup, and the three audit corrections are applied: q6-b 「コミットのあるGitリポジトリなら `claude --cloud` で送れます」, example-habit 「頼りきった人より直後のテストの点が高めでした」, and q3-c 「…のが確実」. The Esc hint and the flashcards are now cited. One UI detail is still untraceable: the p-start expect 「入力欄の上に `cc-practice` が表示されます」.

The lesson uses です・ます throughout in a warm tone (「大切なプロジェクトには影響しません」), with no banned phrases and English on katakana terms at first use. The auto-mode scope is now the same in example-mode and the glossary (「ターミナルとVS Codeの対話セッション」).

Only jp is declared, and it is complete. The diagram has Japanese labels and full alt text, the links are descriptive (「公式ドキュメントの日本語版」, 「インストールのトラブルシューティング」), and the plain-text checklist labels no longer use markdown.

niceToHave: loop-check q1: option a repeats the loop-diagram description (「実行してエラーを読み、直して、また実行します」). To make the learner use the 確かめる stage instead of matching words, give option d the same opening. d md: 「実行してエラーを読み、直したところで完了と報告する」. d feedback: 「直しただけでは、ループの「結果を確かめる」段階が抜けています。もう一度実行して確かめてから報告します。」

loop-diagram: `description` holds an example instead of a text description of the figure, and the reader puts it in a collapsed <details>, so most learners never see the source's failing-tests example. Move 「「失敗するテストを直して」なら、実行してエラーを読み、直して、また実行します。」 into a visible markdown block after the diagram, and either drop `description` (alt already covers the figure) or make it describe the figure.

surfaces-table: the CLI row's 「ネイティブインストーラー（native installer）で入れる」 uses the term before 1-3 and never defines it. Change the cell to 「1-3の方法で入れる」. Change install-how's second sentence to 「推奨は、公式のインストール用コマンドで入れるネイティブインストーラー（native installer）で、自動で更新されます。」.
prerequisites: q2 and surfaces-table depend on push. Change the second item to 「Gitのコミット（commit）とプッシュ（push）の意味がわかる（バイブコーディング第5章）」; vibe-ch5 covers 5-2 commit / push / clone.
install-needs: write 「[[Consoleアカウント]]」 so the glossary entry appears at the term's first use in the body.
example-lead: the example never says the page is already committed, so ③ only works because of a state the practice sets up in p-base. Use 「公式のクイックスタートの順に進めます。題材は、コミット済みの「hello world」の1ページです。」.

practice p-change: Claude made the page in this same session, so ①「このプロジェクトは何をするもの？」 is answered from context, not by reading files. Add to the p-base md: 「コミットしたら `exit` で終え、もう一度 `claude` を起動します。」 (`exit` is in cc-terminal-guide). This also replays the fresh-session idea from 1-4.

factual doubt: the p-start expect 「入力欄の上に `cc-practice` が表示されます」 is an uncited UI detail. A first start in a new folder may also show a folder-trust prompt that the hint does not mention. Safer expect: 「Claude Codeが起動し、入力欄が表示されます。」.
check-quiz q8: 「このレッスンの進め方に沿って」 asks the learner to recall the order, so set bloom to "understand" rather than "apply".

check-quiz q7-a: the feedback corrects only the Node.js belief, but the scenario also has the Free plan. Suggested feedback: 「Node.jsが要るのはnpmで入れる場合だけで、無料プランのままでは使えません。有料プランかConsoleアカウントを用意し、ネイティブインストーラーで入れます。」
practice-steps p-commit has no hint. Add one: 「1つしか並ばないときは、「まだコミットしていない変更はある？」と聞いて、残りをコミットしてもらいます。」
summary: The scope check required a full review: objectives o2 and o3 changed, 32 of 43 blocks changed and 52% of the parts changed. All four round-1 must-fix items are gone: q2 now applies push-before-cloud, Consoleアカウント is explained in install-how and the glossary, practice-steps cites cc-how-it-works, and summary-cards is cited and matches the body. The arc is strong (hook, worked example with a real diff, faded practice, transfer exam); the most useful remaining change is making q1 discriminate on the 確かめる stage instead of matching the diagram description.
